# Founder Simulator — San Francisco

> Founder Simulator (repo gtasf.lol) is a free browser-based 3D open-world startup game set on the real street grid of downtown San Francisco. Story mode has nine chapters, from a Tenderloin SRO to an IPO on Pine Street, with objectives at real OpenStreetMap buildings; free roam lets you drive, explore and take side-gig deliveries.

- Kind: browser game (3D, open world, GTA-style sandbox), desktop and touch
- Stack: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Three.js, React Three Fiber, drei, Zustand
- Assets: Kenney (CC0) characters and vehicles; map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
- Live: https://gtasf.lol
- Run locally: `npm install && npm run dev` (http://127.0.0.1:4001)
